# Modtopia 0.6.1 (MIT, README.md, THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): the mod loader core, vendored unchanged. Portable C11 with no dependencies; the
# runtime's mods host (src/mods/) calls it through sdk/include/modtopia/modtopia_host.h. Its tests, tools and example mods are not vendored.
add_library(nxrt_modtopia STATIC
    core/src/mt_util.c core/src/mt_toml.c core/src/mt_version.c core/src/mt_zip.c core/src/mt_manifest.c core/src/mt_loader.c
    core/src/mt_runtime.c core/src/mt_patch.c core/src/mt_net.c core/src/mt_png.c)
target_include_directories(nxrt_modtopia PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include)
set_target_properties(nxrt_modtopia PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
target_compile_definitions(nxrt_modtopia PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
    target_compile_options(nxrt_modtopia PRIVATE -Wno-macro-redefined)   # mt_util.c defines WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN, which the runtime sets for every target
endif()

# The mappings (mappings/<game version>.toml), embedded: the mods host writes them into the game folder for the core to read
# (modtopia_mappings.gen.h: kModtopiaMappings, one {file name, bytes, size} row a file). Generated at configure time; a changed file
# configures again.
file(GLOB _mt_maps CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/mappings/*.toml")
list(SORT _mt_maps)
set(_mt_gen "// Generated by runtime/third_party/modtopia/CMakeLists.txt from mappings/*.toml. Do not edit.\n#pragma once\n#include <cstddef>\n\n")
set(_mt_rows "")
set(_mt_i 0)
foreach(_f ${_mt_maps})
    get_filename_component(_name "${_f}" NAME)
    file(READ "${_f}" _hex HEX)
    string(LENGTH "${_hex}" _hexlen)
    math(EXPR _size "${_hexlen} / 2")
    string(REGEX REPLACE "([0-9a-f][0-9a-f])" "0x\\1," _bytes "${_hex}")
    string(APPEND _mt_gen "inline constexpr unsigned char kModtopiaMap${_mt_i}[] = {${_bytes}};\n")
    string(APPEND _mt_rows "    {\"${_name}\", kModtopiaMap${_mt_i}, ${_size}},\n")
    math(EXPR _mt_i "${_mt_i} + 1")
endforeach()
string(APPEND _mt_gen "\nstruct ModtopiaMapping {\n    const char* name;\n    const unsigned char* data;\n    size_t size;\n};\n")
string(APPEND _mt_gen "inline constexpr ModtopiaMapping kModtopiaMappings[] = {\n${_mt_rows}};\n")
set(_mt_out "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/gen/modtopia_mappings.gen.h")
file(CONFIGURE OUTPUT "${_mt_out}" CONTENT "${_mt_gen}" @ONLY)
add_library(nxrt_modtopia_mappings INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(nxrt_modtopia_mappings INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/gen")
